correctness.rationale: The parameterization of all derivations is exhaustive in characteristic two; the two coefficient equations exactly encode idempotence. Constant-zero solutions reduce to an idempotent two-by-two matrix plus a constrained row. Constant-nonzero solutions normalize to (1,0) and have exactly two free parameters. Explicit automorphism shears yield all conjugacy classes. One-parameter degenerations and the symbolic linearization yield the geometrically irreducible smooth fourfold. Full enumeration over F2 and F4 checks rank and counts.

value.rationale: The two-variable exponent-two algebra is a natural first nontrivial commutative restricted complete intersection. Its idempotent derivations are precisely toral elements in the small Jacobson–Witt derivation algebra. The complete orbit decomposition, dense stratum whose derivations fail to preserve the maximal ideal, global smoothness and finite-field count across every binary extension are structurally motivated invariants, not merely a one-case numeric observation.
